meta.name: hunt-nextjs
meta.description: Hunt Next.js specific vulnerabilities — Server Actions arbitrary function execution, Middleware auth bypass via static asset paths, ISR cache poisoning, Image Optimization SSRF (/_next/image), RSC payload leakage, getServerSideProps injection, source map exposure, debug endpoint leakage. Use when target runs Next.js 13/14/15 or any React SSR framework.

copy.tagline: 扫描 Next.js 应用的安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责 Next.js 应用的安全测试
copy.tagline_en: Scan Next.js apps for security vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for security testing of Next.js applications

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会专门检查 Next.js 网站的安全漏洞，比如服务器操作绕过登录、中间件权限绕过、图片优化功能的内网请求伪造、缓存投毒、数据泄露等，并给出测试步骤。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 对运行 Next.js 13/14/15 或类似 React SSR 框架的目标网站进行安全测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个 Next.js 网站有没有服务器操作漏洞。
检查这个网站是否有图片优化 SSRF 漏洞。
看看这个 Next.js 站点的中间件能否被绕过。
say.note: Claude 会尝试通过静态路径访问受保护页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will specifically check Next.js websites for security vulnerabilities such as Server Actions auth bypass, Middleware bypass, Image Optimization SSRF, ISR cache poisoning, data leakage, etc., and provide testing steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to perform security testing on a target running Next.js 13/14/15 or similar React SSR framework.

say_en.text: Test this Next.js site for Server Actions vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will attempt to call Server Actions directly to check for auth bypass.

say_en.text: Check this site for Image Optimization SSRF.
say_en.note: Claude will test the /_next/image endpoint for internal network access.

say_en.text: See if the middleware on this Next.js site can be bypassed.
say_en.note: Claude will try to access protected pages via static paths.
